purpose: Train a fresh rank-16 action residual on the frozen I-23 effective model, then select one training time and one residual multiplier without a two-dimensional post-hoc search. The target is action recovery while preserving I-23 material, topic, and all four recommendation domains. This gate is a mechanism and safety protocol, not an online-score estimator.

causal_design.parent_effective_model: O6 base plus the retained I-23 rank-64 adapter
causal_design.trainable_state: fresh zero-effect rank-16 LoRA residual only; every I-23 parameter remains frozen
causal_design.reference_model: an identical frozen I-23 effective model
forbidden_warm_starts: every I-25 checkpoint, including recovered checkpoint-250
every I-25 deterministic replay or recovery checkpoint
causal_design.single_primary_change: relative to I-25, change only output_dir/run_name and save_total_limit from 6 to 7 so Trainer retains all seven direct checkpoints; model, parent, data, shuffle seed, loss, optimizer, schedule, and dose remain identical
causal_design.clean_start_requirement: start from O6 plus the successful immutable I-23 adapter and create a fresh zero-effect r16 residual; no I-25 or replay/recovery artifact may be read as model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, or resume state

launcher_must_refuse_if: this gate file is missing, its status is not PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_I26_FORMAL_LAUNCH, or its observed SHA256 is not printed into the immutable preflight log
any required JSON pointer is missing, empty, or exactly PENDING
any locked file is missing or its observed SHA256 differs
the training config is outside configs/active
the parent adapter, dataset, rank, total-step count, checkpoint schedule, save_total_limit=7, single-GPU rule, or W&B-online rule differs from this gate
the config or any resume argument refers to an I-25, replay, or recovery checkpoint
the output directory already contains artifacts from another run
prelaunch_lock.activation_rule: Before formal launch, replace every required PENDING value with the final path, hash, or scalar, change only the status to PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_I26_FORMAL_LAUNCH, and make both launchers read this gate, enforce all checks above, and print the resulting gate SHA256 into the immutable preflight log. Launcher paths are locked here but launcher hashes are deliberately not stored here; both launchers embed and verify the final gate SHA256, avoiding a circular gate-launcher hash dependency. No threshold, candidate order, or scale may change during activation.

training_invariants.action_supervision: answer body only, including the real close/EOS termination positions defined by the locked trainer
training_invariants.checkpoint_contents: Trainer model-only checkpoints; optimizer, scheduler, scaler, and RNG state are forbidden
training_invariants.kl_position_protocol: parent-to-policy forward KL on every contiguous supervised assistant-response target position, from the first response token through the final formatter-supervised token; no KL position sampling; action gold CE remains restricted to the post-</think> answer body

checkpoint_axis.final_checkpoint_rule: Trainer must directly save checkpoint-1527; launchers must never synthesize, replace, or modify it. Its adapter/config must be byte-identical to root adapter/config; never infer the final or latest checkpoint from modification time

observed_failure.action: none of steps 25 through 200 passed the joint action gate; the maximum improved-row rate was 0.46875 versus the locked minimum 0.55, step50 was the only positive mean gold-sum-logp delta but still had negative top1 delta, and step200 was the only positive top1 delta but had negative mean and only 0.3125 improved rows
observed_failure.topic: seven of eight checkpoints were below the -0.01 topic gold-sum-logp floor; the sole topic pass at step200 still failed action
observed_failure.recommendation: even step25 had parent-to-candidate KL 0.01296/0.01008/0.01142/0.00986 for video/prod/ad/live, all above the locked 0.005 per-domain ceiling

i24_failure_evidence.design_response: I26 does not continue or rescale I24, I25, or any deterministic replay/recovery checkpoint. It repeats the locked I25 recipe from a clean O6+I23 start solely to repair checkpoint retention, then freezes the training checkpoint before any residual-scale protection search.

d_residual_mechanism_and_retention.boundary: action/topic rows are D-class mechanism rows and do not prove generalization; all six held-out task buckets exclude exact I26 training rows

stage_1_training_checkpoint_selection.name: freeze one training time using action mechanism only
stage_1_training_checkpoint_selection.temporary_candidate_identity: I23 plus 1.0 times the checkpoint residual, composed deterministically only for the E action audit
stage_1_training_checkpoint_selection.selection_rule: Evaluate checkpoints in ascending order and stop at the first checkpoint satisfying every Stage-1 requirement. Freeze that checkpoint and its adapter SHA256 before running or inspecting any scale-protection result. Topic, material, recommendation, generation, and structure fields emitted incidentally by a shared script are masked from Stage-1 and may not alter the choice. If no checkpoint passes, reject I26 locally.
prohibited_after_stage_1: replace the frozen checkpoint with a later checkpoint because its scale curve looks better
rank checkpoints by training loss or by the magnitude of action improvement once the minimum mechanism gate is met
change Stage-1 thresholds after observing any result

stage_2_residual_scale_selection.name: on the frozen Stage-1 checkpoint, choose the smallest fully safe multiplier

combined_adapter_spec.runtime_form: one LoRA adapter relative to O6
combined_adapter_spec.temporary_nonselected_scale_artifacts: must be deleted after the gate result is frozen

stage_2_residual_scale_selection.selection_rule: Evaluate scales in the listed ascending order on the one frozen Stage-1 checkpoint and stop at the first scale satisfying every hard requirement. That scale is selected because it is the smallest effective intervention, not because it has the largest local action metric. If no scale passes, reject I26; do not return to a later training checkpoint, interpolate a new scale, add scale 1.0, or relax a threshold.
required_result_record: frozen Stage-1 checkpoint step and adapter SHA256
every evaluated scale in order and every hard-gate boolean
D/E report paths and SHA256 values
combined adapter/config SHA256 values and exact composition audit
the first full-pass scale or the explicit local rejection reason

no_hindsight_constraints: The training checkpoint axis is resolved before the scale axis is opened.
A protection failure at the frozen checkpoint cannot be repaired by choosing another checkpoint after scale results are known.
A passing smaller scale cannot be replaced by a larger scale with a prettier action diagnostic.
Aggregate material or recommendation averages cannot compensate for a failed direction or domain.
Training loss, E-class absolute scores, and any arithmetic online projection are forbidden selection inputs.

final_candidate_and_compliance.preupload_requirement: Only the first fully passing Stage-2 composition may proceed to packaging; this gate itself does not authorize packaging or upload.
final_candidate_and_compliance.artifact_shape: I23 rank-64 plus the selected scaled rank-16 residual must be concatenated into one rank-80/alpha-80 adapter with the exact additive identity recorded above.
final_candidate_and_compliance.required_wording: The runtime submission is one adapter, but it was constructed by concatenating a separately trained residual with I23. It must not be described as a directly trained single-adapter model or as having written organizer approval.
final_candidate_and_compliance.final_round_rule: Use in the preliminary round only as a disclosed gray-area probe unless the organizer gives written confirmation; a final-round reproducible solution requires that confirmation or a direct single-adapter training reproduction.

online_success_rule.primary: material remains 0.2760 and total score exceeds the current 0.9978 leader
online_success_rule.target_behavior: retain I23 prod/ad advantages, do not lower video/live, and recover action without sacrificing topic
online_success_rule.failure: if material returns to 0.2453, close the branch even if action or total local diagnostics improve

interpretation_boundary: All E-class reports are selection or veto diagnostics only; the repository offline evaluator is NOT_CERTIFIED and no E metric may be converted into an expected online score. D-class mechanism and exact-row-excluded retention reports also do not guarantee I23's discontinuous ninth material hit. Passing this gate establishes a tightly scoped upload candidate, not a predicted gain.
